image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of dark, decaying leaf litter. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct yellow/orange irregular spots and bands. Its skin appears wet and smooth. The head is visible on the left, showing prominent parotoid glands, and the body curves towards the right.
